name: standart-npc
author: MondoTruth, Lil Art, IceGlaive, Nokzin, iguera, Claude, and the Ragnarok Offline community
description: Works with or without Lil Art's cash-shop-extended (Find Mods): with it, some NPCs also take Cash Points. Turning the mod on turns on every NPC; switch single ones off with Settings… (Warper, Job Master, Reset Girl, Stylist, Episode Valkyrie and all the others).

settings.label: Switched-off NPCs
settings.description: Filled in by the Settings… window: the NPCs without a setting of their own (Warper, Buffer, Job Master, Reset Girl, Stylist, Episode Valkyrie, Falcon Breeder, Premium Service Manager, Weight Maxxer, Plagiarism Master, Tool Dealer, Smuggler, Card Exchanger, Grade Refiner, Universal Enchanter, Elemental Endower, Welcoming) that are unticked there. Empty = all on.

settings.label: Buffer: buffs
settings.description: Filled in by the Settings… window (Buffer → Choose buffs): the buffs the Buffer casts, as a comma-separated list of codes.

settings.label: Buffer: 4th class buffs
settings.description: Filled in by the Settings… window (Buffer → Choose buffs): the 4th class buffs the Buffer casts, as a comma-separated list of codes. Renewal only. Empty = none.

settings.label: Warper: paid warps for 3rd and 4th classes
settings.description: Characters in a 3rd or 4th class (also Kagerou, Oboro, Rebellion, Spirit Handler, Karnos) pay the Warper 5,000 Zeny for towns, fields and guild castles and 15,000 Zeny for dungeons, instances and guild dungeons. Special Areas stay free. Off = every warp is free.

settings.label: Warper: quest-locked dungeons
settings.description: The Warper only takes a character to Bio Lab, the Culvert, Dewata Dungeon, Nidhoggur's Dungeon and Rachel Sanctuary after the quest that opens their official entrance. Off = every dungeon is open.

settings.label: Stylist: hair style price (Zeny)
settings.description: What a new hair style costs in the Stylist's window. 0 = free.

settings.label: Stylist: hair color price (Zeny)
settings.description: What a new hair color costs in the Stylist's window. 0 = free.

settings.label: Stylist: cloth color price (Zeny)
settings.description: What a new cloth color costs in the Stylist's window. 0 = free.

settings.label: Stylist: outfit price (Zeny)
settings.description: What switching between the standard and the alternative outfit (3rd and 4th classes, Renewal) costs in the Stylist's window. 0 = free.

settings.label: Smuggler: no cards
settings.description: The Smuggler refuses every card, both for sale and as the free item after his quest.

settings.label: Smuggler: no MVP cards
settings.description: The Smuggler refuses cards that an MVP drops, both for sale and as the free item. The list is made at server start from the monster database, so MVPs from other mods count too. Mini-boss cards have a setting of their own.

settings.label: Smuggler: no mini-boss cards
settings.description: The Smuggler refuses cards that a mini-boss (a Boss-class monster that is not an MVP, like Angeling or Eclipse) drops, both for sale and as the free item. The list is made at server start from the monster database.

settings.label: Smuggler: no costumes
settings.description: The Smuggler refuses costume items (anything worn in a costume slot: headgear and garment), both for sale and as the free item.

settings.label: Smuggler: banned item IDs
settings.description: Filled in by the Settings… window (Smuggler → Options…): item IDs the Smuggler refuses, comma-separated. The list goes on in the next two settings.

settings.label: Smuggler: banned item IDs (2)
settings.description: Filled in by the Settings… window: the banned item IDs that do not fit in the first setting.

settings.label: Smuggler: banned item IDs (3)
settings.description: Filled in by the Settings… window: the banned item IDs that do not fit in the first two settings.

settings.label: Attendance Check
settings.description: The game's own Attendance Check window (replaces the Daily Rewards NPC): one reward a day, sent by mail, 20 days that start over after day 20. A missed day does not reset progress; progress is per account. Rewards differ between Renewal and Pre-renewal.

settings.label: Attendance Check: Renewal rewards, days 1-10
settings.description: Filled in by the Settings… window (Attendance Check → Rewards…): item ID:amount for days 1-10, comma-separated. An empty place, or an item the server does not know, keeps the mod's own reward for that day. Empty = all default.

settings.label: Attendance Check: Renewal rewards, days 11-20
settings.description: Filled in by the Settings… window (Attendance Check → Rewards…): item ID:amount for days 11-20, comma-separated. An empty place, or an item the server does not know, keeps the mod's own reward for that day. Empty = all default.

settings.label: Attendance Check: Pre-renewal rewards, days 1-10
settings.description: Filled in by the Settings… window (Attendance Check → Rewards…): item ID:amount for days 1-10, comma-separated. An empty place, or an item the server does not know, keeps the mod's own reward for that day. Empty = all default.

settings.label: Attendance Check: Pre-renewal rewards, days 11-20
settings.description: Filled in by the Settings… window (Attendance Check → Rewards…): item ID:amount for days 11-20, comma-separated. An empty place, or an item the server does not know, keeps the mod's own reward for that day. Empty = all default.

settings.label: Bounty Hunter
settings.description: Hunting contracts at the Bounty Hunter, Prontera (147,169); one contract per board at a time. Target Hunt (was Gramps): pick a map, Lv 70-231+ (Pre-renewal: to 125), EXP. Overlook Water Dungeon: Lv 30-85, 4 floors in order; all 4 = a card of your choice. Illusion Dungeons (Renewal only): 9 dungeons, Lv 99+, EXP. Daily Area Purge (was Lucky John): 500 kills a day in a random area, EXP and Zeny.

settings.label: Cheffenia MVP Dungeon
settings.description: Timed MVP dungeon access, paid in Zeny or Cash Points. Prontera (140,180).

settings.label: Training Dummies
settings.description: A training dummy for testing damage output. The Dummy Master sets its size, element, race, DEF, MDEF and type (Normal, Boss, MVP). Prontera: dummy (156,225), Dummy Master (150,225).

settings.label: Medium and MVP dummies
settings.description: Two more fixed dummies by Lil Art: a Medium Dummy and an MVP Dummy (Large, Boss, MVP; on Renewal both have 120 DEF/MDEF and the MVP one takes 90% less damage). Needs Training Dummies on. Prontera (153,163) and (158,163).
